title: Gem Sweeper
description: Dig up the board without hitting a hidden rock! The numbers tell you how many rocks touch each square. Flag the rocks and uncover every gem tile to win.
instructions: Click or tap a square to dig it.
Right-click, long-press or switch to flag mode to mark a rock.
Keyboard: arrows move, Space digs, F flags.
Numbers show how many rocks touch that square.
